description: From the headland, the Tower of Hercules rises against the night — the ancient Roman lighthouse floodlit, its beacon glowing from the top while the Atlantic lies black around the point. The two-thousand-year-old tower stands at the frame's center, waves breaking faintly on the rocks below. The oldest working lighthouse in the world, still guiding ships after twenty centuries.
